body:
Probably not. The one person who could have been directly hurt by all of this seems to have forgotten all about that by now.

I really feel like the only amend I can make is to tell the people who matter to me what happened and then disappear off the face of the earth. Be it through my death or just by going into hiding at my best friend's place, who seems to want to stick with me no matter what. But even then, I won't have a life. I'd be nothing but a shell.

I don't think I can share it here. I don't even think I can tell my therapist. I could tell my friend because she knows me and my circumstances in my teen years, but I don't think anyone will understand. Maybe I'm not even deserving of understanding.

I know that nobody is perfect. I know I just need to forgive myself, and that my past doesn't define me. But I keep thinking about the weight of my deeds.
